verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is a SaaS platform that holds customer and payment data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers subscriptions, invoicing, retries, the MCP server, the CLI and pricing complaints. None of it documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
